checks.description: All candidates have positive own-history movement
Candidate rows are unique and sorted
Compiled note classifications match golden fixture
Five bounded and five open-ended intervals
No-impact/stable notes cannot become positive cost evidence
Improved roads do not infer a cost decrease
Four global and six route-scoped notes
Mandatory adversarial case catalogue is present
Full supplied verdict and evidence mapping matches fixture
Adversarial provider responses are rejected and valid response is accepted
One explanation record exists per packet
Source inputs are byte-identical after evaluation
Required normalized inputs contain no missing values
Operational and evidence answer templates remain distinct
All answered claims pass registry grounding
Golden execution does not mutate the snapshot
Answer composers consume stored tool records
Evaluation supplies one captured snapshot per case
Operational answers state the non-evidence boundary
All golden plans match their expected semantics
Stale context is rejected by the service
Golden cases cover every supported intent
Template planning uses no hosted provider
Wrong-route/wrong-date positive note does not change decisions
High-similarity no-rate-change note does not change decisions
Context-note row permutation preserves compiled notes
Note order does not change evidence decisions
Output directory variation is covered by isolated reproducibility runs
Shipment row permutation preserves candidate calculations
Shipment row permutation preserves sorted weekly metrics
Every unexplained anomaly has one operational analysis
All reference weeks strictly precede their candidate week
Both independent lenses reconstruct the canonical own-history gap
Operational analyses retain the unexplained canonical verdict
CSV values reconcile with typed pipeline output
Every logical record has eight fields
All deliberate CSV corruptions are detected
Matched note appears only on justified rows
Percentage displays use explicit sign and one decimal
CSV is valid UTF-8 and parseable
Reason note IDs agree with matched/supporting authority
Exactly one row per authoritative candidate
All final CSV files are byte-identical
Formal evaluation uses exactly three runs
Every isolated pipeline subprocess exits zero
Every selected/supporting supplied note reaches the Evidence Gate
Labelled supplied discovery set is non-empty
Every weekly rate equals aggregate freight divided by aggregate tonne-km
Group shipment counts range from 3 through 5
